en.t: I do not really mind that my face is swollen.

units.source_text: 这里乱糟糟的，真不好办。”

en.t: Things are such a mess here; it is really hard to manage.

units.source_text: 名人来回抚摸着自己的胸口，对学艺部长久米陈述自己的病痛。

en.t: The master kept rubbing his chest back and forth as he described his illness and pain to Kume, the head of the arts department.
